About

I'm a B.Tech Information Technology student who likes turning an idea into a working application. My focus is Full Stack Development, and I bring in Artificial Intelligence where it helps. I enjoy Problem Solving and Building Practical Applications end to end.

My projects cover a multi-tenant real estate platform, an LLM-based interview chatbot, a MEAN stack expense tracker and a quantum machine learning model for anemia prediction.

The anemia prediction work reached the National Round of the World Computer League Hackathon (WCHL). I have also completed workshops on Prompt Engineering and Power BI.
